title: EntropyMoE: Entropy-Aware Sparse Expert Routing for Tokenizer-Free LLMs
description:
arXiv:2608.06398v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent byte-level large language models (LLMs) have made tokenizer-free modeling increasingly competitive by grouping bytes into dynamically sized patches. However, existing byte-patch architectures still apply the same dense feed-forward computation to every patch.
